tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find Singapore registered entities by name or UEN. Matches an exact UEN, an exact name, or names that START WITH the query (case-insensitive). Live entities and shorter names rank first. Returns up to 10 compact results; call get_company with a UEN for the full record.

query.description: Entity name (or its beginning) or a UEN, e.g. "Singapore Airlines" or "197200078R".

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get the public registry record of one Singapore entity by its UEN: name, entity type, status and status date, incorporation date, SSIC activities, registered address (when shown publicly), conversion successor, SGPID and its sgpbusiness.com profile link, plus the open-data attribution to include when presenting it.
